title: PR #79: docs: make all Markdown machine-readable
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: True

Introduces ATC-MD-001. Every tracked Markdown file is represented exactly once in a machine-readable registry with path, exact blob SHA, deterministic document type and lifecycle. Adds JSON Schema, contract documentation and a CI gate that fails on missing/stale/duplicate Markdown registry entries. Current corpus: 4,139 Markdown files. This is metadata/evidence infrastructure and does not imply implementation or release status.
